Fix = add 2 re-exports, derive IDS from harnessreg.ids(), reorder docs-only before _uncommitted_not_in. chunk_findings.detail: A committed docs-only diff plus uncommitted source no longer stays on the full gate list. Previously, after `paths = diff()` and `chosen = gates`, `_uncommitted_not_in(tree)` returned the full pipeline before either reduced branch, because both reduced pipelines skip review and whole-suite ci. The replacement comments that only the trivial tier does that and then does `if diff_is_docs_only(...): chosen = doc_pipeline` / `elif diff_is_trivial(...)`. `diff_is_docs_only` is given only the committed `paths`, and the `elif` is never reached when that claim is true. Given a docs-only commit and an untracked or dirty `.py` outside that diff, the call selects `doc_pipeline` and skips the gates the removed check existed to keep.

data.probe: The removed fail-closed was regression 06dc238c2 (rubber_duck r2) that broke the 4 committed docs-only diffless completion tests (test_diffless_callers_share_the_pipeline_from_the_diff, test_the_real_diffless_callers_use_the_diff_pipeline, test_complete_accepts_a_docs_only_change_with_the_doc_gates_alone, test_a_research_item_with_a_docs_diff_runs_the_doc_pipeline_and_completes). The finding claims untracked source beside a docs-only commit now escapes; that fail-closed is RETAINED on the trivial path in diff_is_trivial (its own _uncommitted_not_in), which is the tier that skips the whole suite+review -- tests/test_trivial_tier.py::test_an_untracked_file_beside_a_docs_only_change_is_not_trivial and the dirty/staged siblings all still pass. The docs-only path is keyed to the committed diff alone for the merged/diffless callers, which is the end-to-end spec. Refixed here by removing only the pipeline_by_diff-level overreach, not the trivial fail-closed.
